comparison.objective: Candidate installs a rigid rack rail; record routes a deformable cable between posts into a second clip while preserving the first clip.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests rigid long-part support, staged spring-prong latching, telescoping, and fastening; record tests deformable slack management and bimanual cable seating.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks rack-unit registration, four prongs, spring extension, prescribed screw holes, self-support, and 3 s hold; record checks connected-span routing, two clip seats, arm participation, release, clearance, and 2 s hold.
comparison.reason: Both preserve an earlier attachment while securing a later one, but rigid rail registration and load-bearing mechanical latches are meaningfully different from deformable routing. Candidate force and geometry thresholds remain unspecified.
